title: Boljoon Church
geometryBasis: Named original church and attached ranges way 542521547, with all sixteen exterior corners. The National Museum records the nave, east pediment and round arch, trefoil niche, coral stone buttresses, convent and north belfry.
sectionBasis: Original provider forecourt datum. Written 39 and 28 degree roof pitches retained. Nave width and plan use the mapped dimensions. Independent belfry dimensions, grade and roof profile are estimates from its documented role and position.
limitations: The complete mapped church and adjoining convent follow the original sixteen-corner outline. Internal massing divisions, eaves, ornament, openings and the palette are estimates from written facts and the mapped exterior.
The north belfry location follows the museum description. Its footprint, heights and roofing profile are estimates. The separately named El Gran Baluarte and other outbuildings are outside scope.
The National Museum reports upper and lower main-roof slopes of 39 and 28 degrees and the 2007 galvanized iron covering. The position of the slope break is estimated.
The field preserves the original provider samples. The entrance and foundation are registered to approximate local grade.
